Aspera Connect companion — phone install
========================================

Version: 0.3.4 (light theme + hang up)

Favorites & Recents are on the DESKTOP app only — update the PC binary
for those. Phone update is for light theme + hang-up.

  curl -L -o /tmp/AsperaConnect-0.3.4.apk \
    "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ramchandragada/asperaconnect/cursor/phone-contacts-sync-5b4f/dist/release/AsperaConnect-0.3.4.apk"
  adb install -r /tmp/AsperaConnect-0.3.4.apk

Open app → allow Phone, Answer phone calls, Contacts → Start for calls.
Confirm version shows v0.3.4.
